# Find a team for your projects

In this page we post projects that need talents through collaboration.
The aim of this page is to increase collaboration between people from different
research groups, institutions, universities and countries.

If you have a project, an idea or an inspiration and you need a team to
co-create your wonders into reality, contact us by email and we will post
your project here.

<br>
